title: JAYFIELDCOIN
tagline: We're deploying smart cotracts on Skale! DEPLOYING VIDEOS TO LIVEPEER ON SKALE WITH ALLURE TOKEN.
description:
Livepeer to deploy videos that pay people to watch. Using the SDK, deploying a video using three actors. 

Allure token to purchase equity in video. or in the individual actor.. 

Skale Network for transactions. With zero gas transactions, people are able to easily buy the asset and stake in the individual.
how_its_made:
Using Allure token, people stake in the video and earn interest for watching. An ERC20 token is used to transfer into the wallet of owners. While the digital asset creates interest, the distribution of funds is divided amongst the steamers, actors and publisher. 

Using SkaleNetwork, all on chain activity is recorded with transfer and distribution.
